profile.headline: Senior Backend Engineer | Elixir, Python, Distributed Data Systems
profile.summary:
I build and operate the backend systems behind real-time, data-intensive products.

I'm currently a Senior Backend Engineer on the Quantitative Sports team at Hard Rock Digital, building the in-house pricing engine that generates and updates live betting odds for millions of users in real time. It's low-latency, high-throughput work at the intersection of distributed systems and quantitative modeling, exactly the kind of problem I like to sit with.

Before this I spent two-plus years at Penn Interactive (theScore / ESPN BET) on the platform that ingests live sports data from 14+ providers and publishes it to the apps, sportsbook, and odds-modeling systems that depend on it. I designed and led the simulation/replay platform now used as the primary QA surface across engineering, and helped modernize legacy workflows onto our Oban-based pipeline.

Earlier, I was a founding engineer on the Automate team at Primer.ai (NLP / ML model management, where I watched the company grow from 30 to 130 people) and led search-performance and ingestion work at Proton.ai.

I'm a backend engineer by training; Elixir and Python deepest, Ruby and others when needed. The work I get the most out of sits at the intersection of distributed systems and developer experience. Lately that's meant a lot of agentic AI tooling: RAG-style codebase knowledge bases, custom domain skills, and PR automation.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Building the next generation of Hard Rock Digital's in-house sports pricing engine as part of the Quantitative Sports team, the low-latency, high-throughput system that generates and updates live betting odds for millions of users in real time. My work focuses on backend services across the pricing pipeline, from multi-feed data ingestion through odds aggregation and publishing, partnering closely with quantitative analysts to bring probability and pricing models into reliable production systems under 24/7 uptime and high-concurrency demands.
positions.insights: Skills: Python · Sports · Microservices · Software Design · Software Development · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Apache Kafka

positions.title: Backend Software Engineer
positions.description:
Owned core pieces of Penn’s real-time sports data platform — the system that ingests live data from 14+ third-party providers, normalizes it, and publishes 25M+ Kafka messages per day to downstream consumers including the mobile app, sportsbook, and odds-modeling team.

Led the design of the two-stage simulation/replay platform now used as the primary QA surface across engineering. Standardized the team’s workflow architecture during a company-wide Oban migration, codifying the fetcher/processor pattern via custom Credo CI checks. Built the team’s agentic AI tooling layer — domain-specific skills, wiki+RAG knowledge bases, and PR automation.

Stack: Elixir, Phoenix, Ecto, Oban, Kafka, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes, Terraform, Datadog.
positions.insights: Skills: Elixir · Ruby · Erlang · Oban · Ruby on Rails

positions.title: Backend Software Engineer
positions.description:
B2B real estate data platform. Reduced ingestion time 20% for a daily pipeline processing 400K+ scraped property listings. Expanded data coverage 15% by integrating new U.S. Census Bureau sources into the existing Dagster pipeline.

Stack: Python, AWS (Lambda, EC2, S3), PostgreSQL, Dagster, CircleCI.

positions.title: Backend Software Engineer
positions.description:
B2B sales analytics platform for wholesale distributors. Cut ElasticSearch search latency 40% through query and indexing improvements; reduced data inaccuracies 33% via a cross-functional validation strategy; migrated the application framework from Sanic to FastAPI for cleaner code and better documentation.

Stack: Python (Sanic / FastAPI), GCP, ElasticSearch.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Elasticsearch · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · Elastic Stack (ELK)

positions.title: Backend Software Engineer
positions.description:
Founding engineer on Automate, Primer’s flagship ML labeling and model management product. Watched the company grow from 30 to 130 people during my tenure.
Authored specs, designed data models, built APIs, drove customer outreach. Led the document ingestion pipeline rewrite that decreased execution time 35%, built entity resolution at ingestion time, and designed support for binary/multiclass/multilabel classifier displays. Cut model deployment costs 30% across 50+ users. Led the Financial Times ingester migration off StreamSets (Goldman Sachs downstream user) on a hard mid-January deadline. Mentored new hires through onboarding, code review, and pair programming.

Stack: Python (Flask, Django, FastAPI), PostgreSQL, Kubernetes, Docker, Kafka, Datadog, AWS.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Flask · Apache Kafka · Microservices · Go · Kubernetes

positions.title: Project ArchiTech
positions.description:
Project ArchiTech tries to solve the problem of 'zoning analysis' for a property so that a broker/home owner can assess how much extra space they can add to their existing property. 

Since mapping API's only provide 3D views for existing buildings out of the box, we used Mapbox's layering feature to introduce 3D rendering of new buildings/additions to an existing property by feeding curated geojson to it (that we generated in QGIS).

I contributed to design decisions/implementation on the front end using React & helped discern MapBox's API functionality on the back end.
positions.insights: Skills: Front-End Development · Software Development · React.js · JavaScript

positions.title: Software Engineer Affiliate
positions.description: Contracted by PhD researchers to build a web-based dashboard for MatLab visualizations — mapped to 3D ThreeJS objects wrapped in React components. GraphQL stack (Apollo, Graphene) with Flask/PostgreSQL backend. Showcased at the 2020 National Energy Storage Summit.
positions.insights: Skills: HTML · Front-End Development · Git · Software Development · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · React.js · Django · Representational State Transfer (REST) · JavaScript

projects.title: Automate — no-code, NLP/ML, custom and off the shelf model platform
projects.description: Build your own models from scratch, retrain our world-class models for your specific task, or use Primer models off-the-shelf. Anyone in your organization can build and train models using Primer Automate — no coding or technical skills required.
